Highway 1 Westbound Closed After Early Morning Crash

A serious crash occurred on Highway 1 in Burnaby, Canada, shortly before 12:30 a.m. The incident led to the closure of all westbound lanes between Kensington Avenue and Sprott Street, causing significant traffic delays.
